title: Road traffic counts (hourly), Mobility Office
summary: Hourly vehicle counts per road counter (counter_id, ts_local, vehicles), described in the catalog as counters near the city's monitoring stations. Catalog states about 15 million rows, temporal coverage from 2021-01-01 with no end date, hourly refresh (last refreshed 2026-10-12). Counter-to-monitoring-station mapping and distances are not documented. Counter replacement on 2024-03-18 changed the counting method (per direction before, both directions combined after), and the wiki says no adjustment has been applied or documented in the catalog.

schema.notes: No counter location, direction, or station mapping fields documented. Sample not read (internal, access by request).

spatial.code_system: counter_id (free road-counter code; no geocode or station mapping documented)
spatial.notes: Location described only as near monitoring stations; no coordinates, addresses or station key provided in catalog or wiki.

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: catalog entry classification 'internal'; no licence field in catalog

documentation_excerpts: Vehicles counted per hour by road counters near the monitoring stations.
On 2024-03-18 the road counters were replaced.
Before that date, counts were recorded per direction. From 2024-03-18, counts are both directions combined.
Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it. The catalog entry for `traffic.hourly_counts` has no note about this.
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30 (station_network wiki, relevant to any station-level join).
quality_notes: Method break on 2024-03-18: counts per direction before, both directions combined after (wiki counter_replacement_2024, last_edited 2024-04-02). Catalog entry has no note; comparisons across the change are not valid without adjustment.
Catalog says counts are 'near the monitoring stations' but no counter-to-station mapping or distance is documented anywhere checked.
Timestamp is ts_local (local time, timezone/DST handling not documented) while the city air-quality source uses ts_utc; alignment needed before joining.
Coverage/completeness of 2024-2025 hours per counter is not documented; the catalog only gives an approximate row count (about 15 million).

Related: station VR-03 (Via Roma) stopped reporting on 2024-06-30 (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01) although airq.station_readings lists the network as active; any traffic-to-station join must exclude it after that date.
Catalog and wiki are consistent on the counter replacement; no conflicting dates found.

provenance.claim: Catalog fields: owner Mobility Office, steward Luca Ferri, grain hourly, coverage 2021-01-01 to open, refresh hourly, last refreshed 2026-10-12, ~15M rows, columns counter_id/ts_local/vehicles, access warehouse_sql by request
Counters replaced 2024-03-18; per-direction before, both directions after; do not compare without adjustment; catalog has no note
Station VR-03 switched off 2024-06-30; airq catalog still lists network as active
